mean_co_concentration.instruction: Estimate the mean carbon monoxide concentration in a laboratory gas chamber during this five-minute window.
mean_co_concentration.field_description: sensor_resistance_megohm lists the arithmetic mean, minimum and maximum resistance in megaohms of each metal oxide sensor over a five-minute window. R1 through R7 are Figaro TGS 3870-A04 sensors and R8 through R14 are FIS SB-500-12 sensors. relative_humidity_pct_mean and temperature_c_mean give mean relative humidity in percent and mean chamber temperature in degrees Celsius over the same window.
